recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-34323 unless the external CDS Hooks clinical reasoning IG later reintroduces spaces in StructureDefinition.name.
issue_request: FHIR-34323 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction requesting removal of spaces from the CDSHooksServicePlanDefinition StructureDefinition.name value, which had appeared as "CDS Hooks Service PlanDefinition".
initial_application: Commit a21a521bb156c9f8409bb9effce318a10f54b85c changed the core PlanDefinition CDS Hooks StructureDefinition name to "CDSHooksServicePlanDefinition" and updated related core CDS Hooks PlanDefinition references; merge commit 1156da3afc653068c1169ba21e477d5e04ee5211 brought that work in, and the R5 published profile JSON reports the corrected no-space name.
additional_context: PlanDefinition remains active in source/fhir.ini, but current source has no source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-profile-cdshooksserviceplandefinition.xml and source/plandefinition/list-PlanDefinition-packs.xml contains no CDS Hooks pack entry. Later Applied issue FHIR-53085 moved the CDS Hooks clinical reasoning profiles and mappings from core to the Using Clinical Reasoning with FHIR IG; the moved IG source also uses name "CDSHooksServicePlanDefinition".
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current FHIR core source is already correct for FHIR-34323: the original R5 defect was fixed, and the current core build no longer owns the affected profile.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision that moved CDS Hooks clinical reasoning profiles and mappings from FHIR core into the Using Clinical Reasoning with FHIR IG, making the corrected core profile no longer part of the current core build.
